name: First-price sealed-bid auction
summary: Blind auction where all bidders submit one private bid; highest bidder wins the item and pays the price they bid.
rules_text: Each bidder has a private valuation for the item, unknown to others, drawn from a common prior. Simultaneously and without communication, every bidder submits a single sealed numeric bid not exceeding their budget. After all bids are submitted, they are revealed. The bidder with the highest bid wins the item. In case of a tie, winner is chosen randomly. The winner's payoff is their valuation minus their bid, losers get zero. The winner pays their bid to the auctioneer. No further rounds occur. The goal is to maximize expected profit, balancing higher win chance against paying more.
rating_reason: Sealed-bid auction is perfect hidden-bid numeric game
